meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫一遍各平台短篇热榜,提前发现下一个会火的故事题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写短篇网文却拿不准什么题材当下会火
copy.tagline_en: Scan short-story charts across platforms to catch the next hot topic early
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short web fiction and want to know which topics are trending.

howto.what: Claude 会以短篇网文市场分析师的身份工作:采集或读取知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台榜单数据,产出一份扫榜报告,含情绪热度排行、题材热点、风口预警和值得写的方向。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜,或提到「短篇什么火」等关键词时触发。可直接开写或转长篇扫榜。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的短篇榜,看虐恋还有没有风口
say.note: 产出带风口预警和有效期的报告

say.text: 七猫短篇最近什么火?我想写女频
say.note: 先问平台方向,再给题材候选

say.text: 对比一下点众和黑岩短篇的热门题材

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a short-web-fiction market analyst: it collects or reads chart data from Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong and similar platforms, then produces a scan report with emotion rankings, hot genres, surge alerts and directions worth writing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you enter /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or mention keywords like "what's hot in short stories". You can also jump straight to writing or to long-form scanning.

say_en.text: Scan the Zhihu Yanyan short-story chart and tell me if 虐恋 is still rising
say_en.note: Report with surge alerts and expiry dates

say_en.text: What's hot in Qimao short stories? I want to write female-lead
say_en.note: Asks platform and direction first, then candidates

say_en.text: Compare hot genres on Dianzhong and Heiyan short stories
